marks.label: Battery
marks.seen: black rectangular battery on right side

marks.label: Positive (+) terminal
marks.seen: red plastic cover over battery terminal

marks.label: Negative (−) terminal
marks.seen: exposed metal terminal with cable connection

photo_instruction: Open the hood and take a picture of the battery from above.
steps: Look for white or green crust on the terminals (corrosion).
To replace: take the negative (−) cable off first, then the positive (+).
Remove the hold-down clamp and lift the battery out (it is heavy).
Put the new one in, tighten the clamp, connect positive (+) first and negative (−) last.
title: Battery check or replacement
warnings: Battery safety: take off the negative (−, black) cable first and put it back last. Never let a metal tool touch both terminals or the terminal and the car body. No sparks or flames nearby.
